name: 07-stale-day-boot-43c2b16
description: Camera powered off in daylight, left until after dark, then booted: it reads a dead-zone day-pipeline gain (1500 - dark but not railed, so the fixed night crossing at 3000 need never fire) and adopts the stale persisted DAY. Pre-fix that state had no deadline at all - every self-healing path was gated on cur==NIGHT - and the camera rendered a black day-pipeline scene indefinitely. Post-fix the adopted day gets the same verify deadline: still ambiguous at the deadline with no improvement (flat scene, no brightening extension), so it must fall to the recoverable side within DN_ADOPT_PROBE_S plus the ordinary switch path's hysteresis.
